name: Training for Horticulture Skill Development for Self-Employment at Centre of Excellence
nodalDept: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
briefDescription: The scheme "Training for Horticulture Skill Development for Self-Employment at Centre of Excellence " is aimed at promoting self-employment opportunities across all communities in Gujarat through practical and theoretical learning at the Centre of Excellence.
descriptionMd: The scheme &quot;Training for Horticulture Skill Development for Self-Employment at Centre of Excellence&quot; introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat,  aims to offer structured training programs ranging from 10 to 30 days, focusing on horticultural skills to enable self-employment. The program is tailored for individuals across all social categories, with subsidized training costs. Beneficiaries gain access to a complete learning experience, including expert sessions, training literature, educational tours, and practical kits.
benefitsMd:
- **Stipend:** ₹250/- per trainee.- **Other Facilities:** Dining facility, training literature kit, experiential education tour, trainee kit, etc.
> **Duration of the Training:**


- Minimum: 10 days
- Maximum: 30 days
eligibilityMd:
The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.
The applicant should belong to any of the following:

- Agriculture Labour
- All Colleges
- All Farmers
- All Individuals
- All Students
- Anganwadi Worker
- College Students
- Farm Labourer
- Horticulturists
- Self-Employment
- Skilled Individual
- Small and Marginal Farmers
- Small, Marginal & Other Farmers
applicationMd:
**Step 1:** Obtain a plain paper application form from the District Office of the Deputy Director of Horticulture.
**Step 2:** Fill in the application form with accurate details. Attach the required documents.
**Step 3:** Submit the form to the District Office of the Deputy Director of Horticulture.
